yatraMatching.title: How to match my practices with a yatra
yatraMatching.intro: A yatra table has one column per yatra practice. Your cell in each column fills from the practice of yours that's linked to it. Until you link one, the cell stays empty, even if you log the practice on Today.
yatraMatching.unmatchedAlt: Yatra settings before any practices are matched
yatraMatching.matchedAlt: Yatra settings with every practice matched
yatraMatching.empty: Your cells in the yatra table stay empty.
yatraMatching.emptyFix: Open Yatra › Your links and link your practice to the yatra practice.
yatraMatching.missing: Your practice isn't offered in the list.
yatraMatching.missingFix: Its type differs from the yatra practice. Pick or add a practice of the same type.

import.subtitle: Load your diary history from a spreadsheet.
import.rule1: First column is the date, as

import.readFailedHint: Make sure it is a text .csv file and try again.

import.overwriteNote: Days in this file that already have entries will be overwritten.
import.noMatchHint: Column names need to match practice names. Rename a column in the spreadsheet, or add it as a practice below.
import.keepOpen: Keep this page open until it's done.

import.errBool: Failed to parse '{{value}}' in '{{column}}': use true, false or leave it empty

yatraSettings.title: Link your practices
yatraSettings.joinedIntro: Link your practices so your entries appear in the yatra table. Practices you leave unlinked just won't show up there.
yatraSettings.wontAppear: Your entries for {{names}} won't appear in the table.
yatraSettings.allAppear: Everything you log on Today appears in the table.
yatraSettings.notLinked: Not linked · your entries won't appear
yatraSettings.linkedTo: Linked to {{name}} · moving unlinks it there
yatraSettings.inactive: Inactive · turn it on in My practices
yatraSettings.leaveText: You'll disappear from its table. Your practices and entries stay in your account. To come back you'll need a new invite.
yatraSettings.lastAdminText: Last yatra admin can't leave. Add another admin or delete the yatra instead.
yatraSettings.bannerText: What you log for {{names}} won't appear in this table.
yatraSettings.newHint: You'll be its admin. Add practices and invite devotees next.
yatraSettings.yatraNameHint: Shown at the top of the table and in invites.
yatraSettings.metricsHint: Adds a 7-day trend column and a 2-week stability heatmap. Both use a 7-day moving average of each member's daily score.
yatraSettings.thresholdsNote: Practices without a threshold add nothing to the score. Yes / No and Text practices can't have one.
yatraSettings.practicesIntro: Drag to reorder: the table shows columns in this order. Tap a practice to edit its colours and score.
yatraSettings.name: Name
yatraSettings.typeFixed: The type can't be changed after the practice is created.
yatraSettings.deletePracticeTextNoStats: Its column and colours are removed for everyone. Members keep their own entries.

yatraSettings.deletePracticeText_other: Its column, colours and the {{count}} statistics that use it are removed for everyone. Members keep their own entries.
yatraSettings.typeSet: Set when the practice was created
yatraSettings.coloursHint: Paint each cell by its value.
yatraSettings.scoreBetterWhen: Daily score is better when the value is
yatraSettings.notSavedYet: Not saved yet. The bar keeps the last valid bounds until this is fixed.
yatraSettings.mustBeAbove: Must be more than {{value}}, the {{colour}} bound
yatraSettings.bonusAtLeast: Must be at least the done value, {{value}}
yatraSettings.bonusAtMost: Must be at most the done value, {{value}}
yatraSettings.scoreHint: Up to 2 points a day from this practice. Shown on the bar above as ✓ and ★.
yatraSettings.scoreDoneBonus: Counts as done at {{op}} {{done}} · bonus at {{op}} {{bonus}}
yatraSettings.scoreNone: Not in the daily score yet
yatraSettings.bonusNote: Bonus only counts on days when every practice with a done threshold is done.
yatraSettings.noZonesBool: Yes / No practices show ✓ in the table. Colours and the daily score only apply to Number, Time of day and Duration practices.
yatraSettings.noZonesText: Text practices show what was written. Colours and the daily score only apply to Number, Time of day and Duration practices.
yatraSettings.oneAdminRule: A yatra always keeps at least one admin.
yatraSettings.adminHint: Can edit practices, members, statistics and yatra settings
yatraSettings.lastAdminToggle: The only admin. Make someone else admin first.
yatraSettings.removeText: They'll lose access to this yatra's table. Their own practices and entries stay with them, and they can rejoin with an invite link.
yatraSettings.visibleHint: Tiles sit above the yatra table.
yatraSettings.label: Label
yatraSettings.noSumForTime: Sum isn't offered: adding up times of day has no meaning.
yatraSettings.deleteStatText: The tile is removed for everyone.
yatraSettings.deleteYatraText_one: This deletes the yatra for its {{count}} member and can't be undone.
yatraSettings.deleteYatraText_other: This deletes the yatra for all {{count}} members and can't be undone.
yatraSettings.inviteText: Anyone with this link can join {{name}}. After joining they link their own practices.
yatraSettings.shareHint: Share opens your phone's share sheet.
yatraSettings.dangerText: Removes the table, practices, colours, statistics and member list for everyone. Members keep their own practices and entries. This can't be undone.
yatraSettings.typeName: Type the yatra name to confirm
yatraSettings.typeNameHint: The button turns on when the name matches.
yatraSettings.dropAdminText: You'll lose access to this yatra's settings straight away. Only another admin can make you admin again.
yatraSettings.bonusNeedsDone: Set “Done at” first: the bonus only adds to a done day
yatraSettings.nameTaken: This yatra already has a practice with this name
yatraSettings.noPracticesText: Once the yatra has practices, you'll link yours here.
yatraSettings.linksIntro: Each yatra practice shows the entries from one of your own practices. Link once; what you log on Today then appears in the table.
yatraSettings.yourRowToday: Your row in the table today
yatraSettings.noShareHint: Sharing isn’t available in this browser, so the button copies the link instead.
